components.text: Washes the vampire side out of the one on the centre: a vampire becomes human again, a hybrid a plain werewolf, a tribrid a witch and a heretic a siphoner.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does) and must be on the vampire side. An Original or an Original hybrid cannot be cured by it.

A hybrid or a tribrid also loses its sire bond. A refusal gives the ingredients back.

Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.
